# ICC Academy

> > ICC Academy is the official educational platform of the International Chamber of Commerce, offering professional training and certification in international trade, Incoterms®, trade finance, and supply chain finance.

ICC Academy delivers expert-led courses, webinars, and certification programs including the Export/Import Certificate (EIC) and Incoterms® 2020 training. The platform serves global trade professionals through partnerships with institutions like Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS) and features content from leading practitioners at firms like Clifford Chance and Credit Europe Bank.

## Key Topics

- Incoterms® 2020
- Trade Finance
- International Trade
- Supply Chain Finance
- Export/Import Certificate (EIC)
- Documentary Credits
- Executive Education
- International Arbitration
- Dispute Resolution
- Business Development
- ICC Standards
- Trade Compliance
- Strategic Sales in Trade

- [The learning journey: In conversation with our International Trade Programme graduate Aw Hui Sen](https://academy.iccwbo.org/international-trade/article/the-learning-journey-in-conversation-with-our-international-trade-programme-graduate-aw-hui-sen): Graduate interview: Aw Hui Sen on ICC Export/Import Certificate at SUSS

## Incoterms® Resources

- [Insider thoughts: Some FAQs on Incoterms® 2020 with Bob Ronai](https://academy.iccwbo.org/incoterms/article/insider-thoughts-some-faqs-on-incoterms-2020-with-bob-ronai): Bob Ronai from Incoterms® Drafting Group answers FAQs on Incoterms® 2020
- [Incoterms® 2020: CFR or CIF? | ICC Academy](https://academy.iccwbo.org/incoterms/article/incoterms-2020-cfr-or-cif): Key differences between CFR and CIF Incoterms® 2020 rules explained
